fact: The head of the National Council for Persons with Disabilities told COSP16 that Law 10 of 2018 obliges access to ICT, including the internet and e-services, and that a national strategy for technological empowerment of persons with disabilities was being prepared with the communications ministry.
title: إيمان كريم تستعرض جهود مصر في مجال انتفاع الأشخاص ذوي الإعاقة بالوسائل الرقمية بالأمم المتحدة
